question.description: The last question asked by the user.

chatHistory.description:
The chat history that the user has with the assistant.

Last element of the array - most recent {@link QuestionAnswerPair q/a} pair.

regenerationCount.description:
Number of times the user has requested for a response for the same question.

`0` would be the first response, `1` would be first regeneration request, and so on.

title: Parameters representing input of the {@link GenerativeProxy#completion}.
